issues.title: BuildKit host-gateway Subnet Note & BuildRun Micro-VM Startup Benchmark Guide (libracoder/kiri)
issues.remaining: A closed third-party guide announcement, not a reproducible bug report. Its external performance claims are not adopted as Asagiri measurements.

issues.title: Image inspect omits Config.Labels even though labels exist in the exported image config
issues.remaining: Full stored OCI config is retained by image inspect, including Labels, ExposedPorts and StopSignal. The metadata fixture checks those fields through the Docker CLI.

issues.title: Windows: docker build hangs when a RUN step needs network (BuildKit has no usable DNS)
issues.remaining: Default-bridge DNS now uses the reachable bridge gateway whenever a local host resolver needs the agent, including WSL. Local stubs are retained rather than replaced by public resolvers. Protocol/configuration tests cover the non-Mac path; native Windows VPN and BuildKit execution remain unverified.

issues.title: macOS: containers report hundreds of GB of block reads while the guest has no page cache
issues.remaining: The balloon reserves active and mapped file cache, holds capacity for 30 seconds after pressure or substantial refaults, and bounds gradual shrinking. Policy and protocol regressions cover these decisions. Native Mac VM cache retention, block-I/O rates, and throughput remain unverified.

issues.title: Support --cgroup-parent, bridge name option, enable_icc=false and user namespace remap for hosting multi-tenant apps Context
issues.remaining: Implemented the report's explicit-rejection alternative for unsupported parent cgroups, user remapping, and custom bridge names before resource creation. Buildx's default /docker/buildx parent is supported inside Asagiri's delegated tree, with aggregate accounting and per-container controls; arbitrary tenant parents and UID remapping remain unsupported.

issues.title: Podman support
issues.remaining: The author withdrew this proposal after explaining that they misunderstood the project. Asagiri remains its own Docker-compatible engine; this closed discussion does not require a selectable Podman backend.

issues.title: Windows: publishing a port on a host IP (-p IP:port:port) fails with 'Address not available (os error 99)'; 0.0.0.0 is loopback-only
issues.remaining: Implemented the report's clear-limitation alternative: explicit non-loopback Windows host-IP publishing is rejected, while wildcard bindings return a WSL/Windows-LAN warning. Portable address tests cover the policy; no Windows forwarding or firewall rules are installed and native LAN reachability remains unverified.

issues.title: Testcontainers still unusable: /version reports 0.2.0, and wait strategies never see container logs
issues.remaining: Docker compatibility version is separate from AsagiriVersion so SDK version gates pass; own update clients use the product version. Real Java Testcontainers 1.20.3 passes default startup checks, pre-start copy, command execution, two delayed log messages, MySQL 8.0 double readiness, a JDBC query and Ryuk cleanup on the private Linux engine. The check is included in Linux PR/main and both Linux release architectures. Native Mac execution remains unverified.

issues.title: Docker API image inspect returns 404 when the repository slash is URL-encoded
issues.remaining: Encoded repository slashes, mixed-case escapes, version prefixes and invalid escapes are already covered by the live API regression.

issues.title: image store: a shorter rewrite leaves trailing bytes in images.json, and every pull fails
issues.remaining: Image-index read/modify/replace uses a cross-process lock and unique synced temporary files. Concurrent writers and shorter rewrites are tested; a complete typed array with a stale tail is recovered only after saving an exact backup. Incomplete corrupt records remain untouched and return an explicit error.

issues.title: Windows: Docker API ignores Connection: close, so a body-less 204 (container start) hangs Testcontainers for .NET
issues.remaining: Connection: close is honored by the engine and covered by live HTTP probes. A real Windows .NET byte-mode named-pipe regression for 201, 204, 304 and a large response passes the hosted Windows job. End-to-end Testcontainers for .NET with WSL and SQL Server remains unverified.

issues.title: Colima vs Kiri vs Podman
issues.remaining: A pinned private Linux comparison of Asagiri, Docker 29.9.3 and Podman 6.1.3 passed GHA run 43632761522. All 3,600 raw timings, summaries, artifact digest and source identities were independently checked and are retained in docs/benchmarks. The portable harness also accepts Colima sockets; native Mac/Colima VM performance remains unmeasured.

issues.title: Linux: every `docker build` fails — Kiri's internal builder container cannot start (mount rootfs: Resource busy)
issues.remaining: Stopped archive jobs now wait for the chrooted worker and its private mounts to exit before upload/stat completion or download EOF. The delayed-worker negative control reproduces premature completion on 6f7ac86; ce0eb4f passes the completion barrier and real BuildKit builds. The reporter's exact CachyOS host with kernel 7.3.4 and systemd 262 remains unverified.

issues.title: Linux: `docker network create` without an explicit subnet always fails with "no free subnet left" (breaks kind)
issues.remaining: Automatic IPv4 and kind dual-stack creation pass with distinct free subnets. A real kind v0.27.0/Kubernetes v1.32.2 cluster boots on ce0eb4f. The reported pool exhaustion was not reproduced on this private Linux host. The reporter's exact CachyOS host with kernel 7.3.4 and systemd 262 remains unverified.

issues.title: Linux: kind node container gets the bridge gateway (172.20.0.1) as its resolver — DNS inside the node times out
issues.remaining: Gateway and embedded DNS resolve local A/AAAA and public names. A real kind v0.27.0/Kubernetes v1.32.2 node uses the gateway resolver, pulls a containerd image and resolves a peer alias; a pod resolves public DNS and an absolute peer alias through CoreDNS on ce0eb4f. The reporter's exact CachyOS host with kernel 7.3.4 and systemd 262 remains unverified.

issues.title: Linux: container overlay mounts leak across a daemon restart — nothing can start until manually unmounted
issues.remaining: Startup unmounts owned rootfs paths even after the old cgroup is removed, including stacked mounts. Two daemon restarts in the same host mount namespace and a four-mount orphan fixture preserve manual/restart-always containers and writable data on ce0eb4f; the old source retains the orphan mounts. The reporter's exact CachyOS host with kernel 7.3.4 and systemd 262 remains unverified.
